v1.0.1
- Fixed a bug that prevented the game from launching through SteamVR and similar setups.

v1.0.2
- Fixed the connection status incorrectly displaying “Disconnected” when a motorized masturbator was connected.
- Fixed bugs when applying slider adjustments.
- Fixed UI layout misalignment.
- Removed one hairstyle and added seven: two ponytails, Side Bun, Cat-Ear Bob, Uni Short, Cozy Bun, and Cat Low Twintails.
- Added a Quit button to the Environment tab.
- Added an option to automatically switch to the male viewpoint when changing positions. Available in the thumbstick-click mini menu and the Parameters tab. Pressing the primary button three times now also switches to the male viewpoint.
- Added an option for the UI to tilt with your viewing pitch, available in the Environment tab.
- Added a standing pose.
- Added saving for parameter and environment settings, allowing you to instantly restore your favorite setups.
- Added skin tone, nipple color, and makeup intensity sliders. Tanned skin is now available.

v1.0.3
- Improved brightness behavior. Previously, lighting became brighter every time the UI opened; lighting now stays at the selected level when the UI opens.
- Added lighting dimming controls.
- Added an Eye Glow slider, which makes a noticeable difference in darker lighting.
- Expanded candle controls: adjustable range, hue, intensity, and whiteness.
- Added more flexible scaling for the character, environment, and player.
Changing the player’s scale changes their position relative to the UI, which can make the controls considerably harder to use.
- Improved the UI. Scroll positions are now preserved when switching tabs, and additional panels reduce excessive scrolling.
- Improved character save slots. The slot limit has been removed, and each slot displays its hairstyle and hair color for easier identification.
- Added a Heartbeat Volume slider.

v1.0.4
- Fixed a bug that automatically saved gameplay screenshots locally. A debugging and recording feature had accidentally been left enabled. I apologize for this.
- Added support for huge breasts! The size range has increased from 0–100 to 0–400.
- Added a Settings tab at the far right to organize features.
- Added an option to enlarge only the outfit’s breasts to prevent clipping. Without this option, breasts can protrude through clothing and look unnatural.
- Added grip-based movement! The grip and primary button functions can be swapped in the Settings tab.
- Added a UI position reset. Hold the UI button—the secondary button—to bring the UI in front of your eyes.
- Moved options such as world movement and the arousal display toggle into the Settings tab, along with various other UI adjustments.

v1.1.0
- Major improvements to appearance.
- Major improvements to breasts. They now react when touched by your hands. With the UI closed, hold the grip near a breast to squeeze it, or near her head to stroke it. Both interactions increase arousal.
- Added English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese support.
- Fixed arousal failing to increase during cunnilingus animations.
- Added support for rotary devices such as the A10 Cyclone.
- Added rapid, small movements for motorized devices during climax sequences.
